'''Clan Werda''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan active during the [[Third Galactic War]] and the concurrent [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]]. When news broke about the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|duel]] on [[Ruhnuk]] between [[Mandalore the Avenger]] and [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]], Clan Werda chose to abandon Mandalore's [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|faction]] and side with Kol's [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Mail" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Werda was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'', an expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in a message via in-game mail to the player character from [[Jekiah Ordo]] entitled "Update."<ref name="Mail" /> They later appear during the "Chains in the Dark" storyline as part of the forces attacking [[Port Nowhere]].<ref name="Nowhere" />
